artesanoswillys.descripcion: The Jeep Willys, the “Yipao”, is the symbol of Quindío and part of the region's cultural heritage. In this workshop you assemble your own miniature Willys and take home an icon of the Coffee Cultural Landscape.
notas: Wear comfortable clothes.
Ideal for ages 5 to 80.
We come to you: it can be done at your hotel or wherever you are.

artesanosaves.descripcion: A workshop with an association of women heads of household from Armenia who created their own modelling paste for making birds. Mould and paint a bird from the region while they tell you how to recognise it in the countryside, and take your piece home as a keepsake.
notas: Wear comfortable clothes.
Ideal for ages 5 to 80.
We come to you: it can be done at your hotel or wherever you are.

artesanosbalcones.descripcion: The colourful balconies and bahareque (wattle-and-daub) architecture are part of what UNESCO recognised in the Coffee Cultural Landscape. In this workshop you recreate a typical balcony in miniature and take home a piece of that architecture.
notas: Wear comfortable clothes.
Ideal for ages 5 to 80.
We come to you: it can be done at your hotel or wherever you are.

artesanosarcilla.descripcion: Local artisans teach you to work the clay they gather from the rivers of the cordillera. Mould your own piece while you listen to stories of the craft: they collect around a thousand pieces before lighting the kiln, where the pieces are fired for up to 24 hours.
notas: Wear comfortable clothes.
Ideal for ages 5 to 80.

artesanoscesteria.descripcion: Filandia is known for its basket-weaving tradition, a craft handed down from generation to generation using vines and fibres from the region. Weave your own piece with a master artisan and get to know a living tradition of the Coffee Cultural Landscape first-hand.
notas: Wear comfortable clothes.
Ideal for ages 5 to 80.

catacerveza.descripcion: A tasting led by the brewmaster of a craft brewery: a tour of the brewery, the styles and processes, food pairing and a souvenir. Learn to recognise the aroma, colour and flavour of each beer.
notas: Bring comfortable shoes, insect repellent and sunscreen.
Let us know in advance if you have any dietary restrictions.
For over-18s only.

avesconocedores.descripcion: For experienced birders: days out at the best birding spots in the Coffee Cultural Landscape, where eBird records between 170 and 370 species per site. The specialist guide plans the route around the species your group is looking for.
notas: Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots.
If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them.
Bring insect repellent and water; on high-mountain routes, thermal clothing.
Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

barbasbremen.descripcion: Between Filandia and Pereira, Barbas-Bremen is one of the last corridors of Andean forest in the region and home to howler monkeys: the ideal place to hear and see them in the wild, along trails through forest and guadua bamboo.
notas: Bring insect repellent and comfortable, waterproof, long-sleeved clothes.
Low, moderate or moderate-to-high difficulty, depending on the group's fitness.
Ideal for ages 12 to 70.
Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

otunquimbaya.descripcion: A National Natural Parks Fauna and Flora Sanctuary in the Otún River basin: a refuge for the Cauca Guan, a bird endemic to Colombia, and for howler monkeys, less than an hour from Pereira.
notas: Bring insect repellent and comfortable, waterproof, long-sleeved clothes.
Low, moderate or moderate-to-high difficulty, depending on the group's fitness.
Ideal for ages 12 to 70.
Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

rioblanco.descripcion: Just minutes from Manizales, the Río Blanco Reserve protects the city's water and is one of Colombia's best-known birding destinations, famous for its antpitta feeders, which draw birdwatchers from all over the world.
notas: Bring insect repellent and comfortable, waterproof, long-sleeved clothes.
Low, moderate or moderate-to-high difficulty, depending on the group's fitness.
Ideal for ages 12 to 70.
Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

romelia.nombre: Visit to La Romelia · orchids and exotic fruits
romelia.descripcion: A farm near Manizales devoted to orchids, bonsai and fruit trees: tour the nurseries with a guide, visit the main house and taste fruit from the farm, with a traditional country lunch included.
notas: Bring comfortable clothes, closed-toe shoes, a cap, sunscreen, insect repellent and a light waterproof.
Not suitable for people allergic to flowers or pollen.
Minimum 4 people.

avesrancho.descripcion: A wetland in the Barragán River valley and a refuge for waterbirds: a flat, easy route through pastures, lakes and rivers, ideal for the first day of your trip.
notas: Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots.
If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them.
Bring insect repellent, water, a cap and sunscreen: it gets hot at midday.
Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

avescamino.descripcion: The old trail travelled by Humboldt and Bonpland in 1801, through cloud forest at 3,370 m above sea level. It is one of the best places in the country to see the Yellow-eared Parrot, which nests in the wax palm and was on the brink of extinction.
notas: Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots.
If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them.
Bring insect repellent, water, a warm layer and thermal clothing: it is cold early in the morning.
Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

avesbremen.descripcion: A protected area and Important Bird Area (IBA) in the Barbas River canyon, with a walk along a wide, flat track and frequent birdwatching stops.
notas: Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots.
If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them.
Bring insect repellent and water.
Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

avescircasia.descripcion: Watch and photograph birds from the covered terrace of a house whose gardens border the forest, with specialty coffee: no physical effort, and sheltered from sun and rain. Ideal for people with reduced mobility and for photographers.
notas: Wear comfortable clothes in neutral tones; if you have a camera or binoculars, bring them.
Suitable for people with reduced mobility.
Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

avescaicedonia.nombre: Birds · Caicedonia and Sevilla (Valle del Cauca)
avescaicedonia.descripcion: Caicedonia, the “Sentinel of the Valley”, is home to more than 325 bird species among coffee plantations, lakes and wetlands. Short routes with a local guide who is among the leading birdwatchers in Valle del Cauca.
notas: Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots.
If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them.
Bring insect repellent and water.
Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

avescolibri.nombre: Birds · Retorno del Colibrí (feeders and photography)
avescolibri.descripcion: A reserve dedicated to conservation, with gardens and feeders designed for photographing hummingbirds and endemic birds at close range. The activity is almost entirely stationary: a nature photographer's dream.
notas: Departs from Quindío.
Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots.
If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them.

Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

avescampanario.descripcion: Páramo and high Andean forest birds between 3,400 and 4,600 m above sea level: mixed flocks, tapaculos, antpittas and high-altitude tanagers in a landscape of mist and frailejón plants. For birders in good physical condition.
notas: Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots.
Bring thermal clothing, gloves and a warm hat, and plenty of water.
If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them.
Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.
Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

cordilleracomp.descripcion: Meeting in Armenia at 8:00 a.m. to start a tour of southern Quindío. We visit Córdoba, known for the use and preservation of guadua bamboo. saludo.jenny: Hi! I'm Jenny from Espontáneos Travel 🌿 How can I help you?

precios.respuesta: The price depends on the number of people and where you're staying. Tell me how many people and the date, and I'll send you a quote.

pregunta_tipo: what do I need to book?
reservar.respuesta: It's very easy! To confirm your booking we need the full names and ID documents of the passengers, along with proof of payment of the deposit. Once we receive them, we'll send you the formal confirmation of your trip. 🎒

pregunta_tipo: do I have to pay everything in advance?
what payment methods do you accept?
pagos.respuesta:
To book, you pay a 50% deposit. Your quote shows the balance due and the payment deadlines.

Payment methods, in the name of Espontáneos Travel SAS (NIT 902.056.513):
🏦 Bancolombia savings: 756-000062-16
📱 Nequi or Daviplata: +57 317 645 6723
💳 Debit or credit card: secure Wompi payment button

💵 You can pay the balance in Colombian pesos, US dollars or euros.
📩 Send us the receipt on WhatsApp.
⚠️ We only use these methods. If anyone asks you to pay into another account, check with us first.

traslados.respuesta: We provide transfers from El Edén (Armenia) and Matecaña (Pereira) airports to hotels in Quindío and Risaralda, and between Armenia, Pereira and Manizales. The journey takes approx. 1 h.

accesibilidad.respuesta: Yes! We have adapted options and special vehicles so everyone can enjoy the region without barriers. We also have a guide for blind travellers. Ask us and we'll give you personalised advice. ♿

idiomas.respuesta: Guides in Spanish, English, French, Italian and Portuguese (guiding in a language other than Spanish costs extra). On shared tours, the English-speaking guide carries a supplement per service.

clima.respuesta: Mild climate all year round; it can rain in any season. It gets cold in Cocora, in the páramo and among the wax palms.

temporadas.respuesta: High season 2026: Holy Week (28 Mar–5 Apr), school break (3–12 Oct) and the year-end holidays (19 Dec 2026–11 Jan 2027). Prices and availability vary.

cancelacion.respuesta: We understand that plans change. Cancellation terms depend on how far in advance you let us know. Tell me which tour you booked and we'll review your case with an advisor.

pregunta_tipo: how do you support the community?
sostenibilidad.respuesta: We work with farming families, artisans and local guides, with fair pay. We give you water on every tour and a reusable rain poncho (zero single-use plastics), we separate waste and we plant trees to offset our carbon footprint. We reject the sexual exploitation of children and adolescents (ESCNNA).

empresa.respuesta: Hi! We're Espontáneos Travel, a tour operator in the Coffee Cultural Landscape with more than 15 years of experience. We specialise in rural, nature, community and wellness experiences. Our purpose is to connect you authentically and responsibly with the nature and culture of our region. 🌿☕

redes.respuesta: We'd love you to follow us! We're on Instagram and Facebook as @espontaneostravel, and on our official website espontaneostravel.com.

ninos_mayores.respuesta: Of course! For children, some walks require adult supervision and basic fitness. For older adults, we recommend the options that best suit their mobility. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Child rate for ages 3 to 10; children under 3 pay a minimum rate without meals. At Parque del Café, the child rate applies to heights between 91 and 124 cm.

pregunta_tipo: do you have a tour to Cocora and Salento?
where do you pick me up?
tour_compartido.itinerario: Departs from Armenia at 8:15 a.m. to the Cocora Valley: interpretation of the cloud forest and the wax palm at the Bosque de Palmas viewpoint 🌴 (2 to 3 h). Then Salento: a historical walk, time for lunch, the Calle Real, shopping and a coffee tasting ☕. Return to Armenia around 3:30 p.m.
incluye: Entrance to the Bosque de Palmas viewpoint
Visit to Salento and the Calle Real
tour_compartido.operacion: Every day, with a minimum of 2 passengers. Confirm by 8:00 p.m. the day before at the latest.
no_opera: The long holiday weekend of the October school break

asesor.respuesta: I'll put you in touch with an advisor on WhatsApp 💬 (reply in less than 24 h).

tradicional3n.incluye: 3 nights with breakfast and dinner (depending on the hotel), Parque del Café Pasaporte Múltiple with transport, shared tour to Cocora and Salento (guide, transport, viewpoint entrance), transfers, medical assistance

general.que_llevar: To make the most of the Coffee Cultural Landscape, bring very comfortable clothes, sunscreen and insect repellent, stay well hydrated and keep your ID document handy. ☀️💧
general.escnna: Espontáneos Travel rejects the sexual exploitation and abuse of children and adolescents (ESCNNA). Law 679 of 2001 and Law 1336 of 2009.

sostenibilidad.titulo: Tourism that leaves a positive mark
sostenibilidad.intro: We know that tourism transforms destinations. That's why we work hand in hand with communities and the land: farming families, artisans and local guides are part of what we offer, and we support them with advice so their experiences keep their authenticity and quality.

acciones: Water for every traveller on all tours, with no single-use plastics
Tree planting to offset the carbon footprint, with a certificate for agencies
We buy local crafts and food
We advise small producers on designing their experiences
We promote the care of cultural heritage

economico.titulo: The value stays in the region
acciones: We hire local people and use local products and services
Fair pay for staff and suppliers
A catalogue of local products to buy directly from the producer

David.texto: We connected him with engineers who donated a system that automated the drying of his coffee.
